About Me

I initially pursued Information Technology because of my interest in UI/UX design and creating functional, user-friendly digital experiences. Over time, this interest grew into a passion for full-stack development, allowing me to explore both frontend and backend development through web and mobile applications powered by shared backend systems. I also do graphic design, which helps me make my work look good as well as work well. Along the way, I developed skills in software testing, quality assurance, and technical documentation, gaining experience in both building and evaluating software solutions. I've served in key project roles including Lead Developer, Business Analyst and QA Lead, with exposure to software architecture, version control standards and agile team collaboration. I'm also a Top 80 qualifier in the 2026 ServiceNow Tech Hackathon. I take pride in turning ideas into working applications, solving challenges, and delivering quality results. With a growing interest in technopreneurship, I'm always eager to learn, improve, and explore how technology can solve real-world problems.
